info.description: Sales Order – Core transactional document in SAP S4H Sales & Distribution (SD) representing a customer's request to purchase goods or services. Contains header-level commercial terms (VBAK), line-item details with materials, quantities and pricing (VBAP), document flow for delivery/billing traceability (VBFA), business data such as payment terms and incoterms (VBKD), and partner functions like sold-to, ship-to and bill-to parties (VBPA). Key document in the Order-to-Cash (OTC) process.

relations.description_table: Sales Document Header Data – Contains commercial header information for sales orders, contracts, quotations and scheduling agreements including sold-to party, document type, net value, sales area and requested delivery date
Sales Document Item Data – Line-item details for sales documents including material, quantity, pricing, plant, weight, volume, rejection reason and profit center
Sales Document Flow – Tracks the complete lifecycle chain between related documents (order → delivery → billing → accounting) with predecessor/successor links and quantities
Sales Document Business Data – Payment terms, incoterms, pricing date, billing date, exchange rates, customer references and additional commercial conditions at header and item level
Sales Document Partner Functions – Partner assignments (sold-to, ship-to, bill-to, payer, sales employee) for sales documents at header and item level

Quotation Valid From – Start date of the validity period for quotations
Quotation Valid To – End date of the validity period for quotations
Document Date – Date of the sales document as stated by the customer
Sales Document Type – Categorizes the sales document (e.g., OR=Standard Order, RE=Returns, KA=Consignment)
Order Reason – Reason code for the order (e.g., replacement, planned purchase, campaign)
Warranty Start Date – Date from which the warranty period begins for the sold product
Delivery Block – Block indicator preventing delivery creation from this order
Billing Block – Block indicator preventing billing document creation from this order
Net Value – Total net value of the sales order in document currency (after discounts, before tax)
Document Currency – Currency key for all amounts in the sales order
Sales Organization – Organizational unit responsible for selling the products
Distribution Channel – Channel through which the products reach the customer (e.g., wholesale, retail)
Division – Product line or business segment (e.g., motorcycles, marine, power equipment)
Sales Group – Group of sales personnel responsible for processing the order
Sales Office – Physical or virtual office responsible for the sales territory
Document Condition Number – Reference to the pricing condition records applied to this order
Requested Delivery Date – Date the customer has requested for goods delivery
Complete Delivery Indicator – Flag indicating if the order must be delivered in a single shipment
Pricing Procedure – Determines the sequence of condition types (discounts, surcharges, taxes) applied
Shipping Conditions – Defines the shipping method agreed with the customer (e.g., standard, express)
Order-Related Billing Type – Billing document type to be used for order-related billing

Description – Free-text description of the sales order header
Customer Purchase Order Number – The customer's own PO number referenced in the sales order
Customer Purchase Order Type – Type classification of the customer's purchase order
Customer Purchase Order Date – Date of the customer's purchase order
Your Reference – Customer's external reference text for correspondence and tracking
Sold-to Party – Customer number of the party who ordered the goods or services
Cost Center – Cost center for internal cost allocation of the sales order
Last Changed On – Date of the most recent change to the sales order

Customer Group 2 – Second customer classification attribute for reporting and pricing conditions
Customer Group 3 – Third customer classification attribute for reporting and pricing conditions
Customer Group 4 – Fourth customer classification attribute for reporting and pricing conditions
Customer Group 5 – Fifth customer classification attribute for reporting and pricing conditions
Sales Deal / Agreement Number – Reference to a sales deal or master agreement for special pricing
Credit Control Area – Organizational unit responsible for monitoring and managing customer credit limits
Credit Account Number – Customer's credit management account used for credit exposure tracking
Customer Credit Group – Groups customers for differentiated credit checking rules
Credit Release Date – Date the order was released from credit hold
Released Credit Value – Credit value amount released for this sales order
Hierarchy Type for Pricing – Customer hierarchy type used for pricing determination
Usage Indicator – Usage indicator for delivery scheduling and availability check
MRP for Delivery Schedule Type – MRP relevance indicator for scheduling agreements
Company Code for Billing – Company code to which billing revenues are posted
Material Availability Date – Date from which materials must be available for the order
